integrity.claim_scope: One k>=3 directional multivariate excursion theorem with PAV solution, equal-level law, four three-age phases and a non-C2 pooling boundary.
integrity.verification: Proof plus embedded standard-library finite diagnostics; no external formal certification.

scientific_limitations: Fixed finite N>=4, 2<=m<=N-2, 3<=k<=N-m+1, independent Brownian coordinates and uniform size-m Poisson batches only.
Exact logarithmic simultaneous positive-tail exponent and conditional scaled-age concentration; no polynomial prefactors, finite-threshold error bounds, or results for k>N-m+1.
Existing stationary marginal recursions, Marshall-Olkin age dependence and all bivariate tail results are acknowledged as prior.
Scientific correctness and publication priority have not undergone independent validation.
title: Multivariate excursion cones and optimal age pooling under batch resetting
